condition_1_separation.statement: at least one pair of methods separates beyond the bootstrap intervals at some budget

condition_2_calibration.statement: the learned content-axis twist is better calibrated than the plug-in noise-axis twist on held-out prefixes
condition_2_calibration.criterion: learned R^2 higher and RMSE lower than the plug-in at every step, both against the realized full-future log-mean-exp target on the same 500 fresh prefixes
